method: Visually inspected all five supplied contact sheets, each displaying 12 sampled images, plus independently extracted and viewed a full-resolution 26-second frame from each original video. Read VIDEO-INVENTORY.json. This is sampled visual review, not complete real-time playback or physical product testing.

audio.evidence: Inventory reports AAC audio streams. No actual listening tool was used. Audible wording, music rights, levels, sync and pronunciation are unverified; subtitles below are visual text only.

common.end_card_tagline: Thoughtful finds for a brighter everyday.
common.brand_observation: Rozmiso wordmark and boxed R symbol visible on all end cards. No other brand or exact manufacturer model is legible in the sampled images.
common.quality: All five have a consistent portrait composition, cream end cards, dark serif product/price text, white Roman-Hindi subtitles on translucent horizontal panels, and visible small sparkle/diamond marks in several lifestyle shots. Their provenance is not determined by this review. Preserve required provenance labels. Contact-sheet downscaling limits small-text inspection.
publication_dependencies: Validate each embedded selling price against owner-approved catalog price.
Validate actual Cash on Delivery availability before publishing any of these unchanged creatives.
Verify rozmiso.in destination and the actual shop CTA route. A plain organic caption does not itself create a tappable Shop Now button.
Match exact supplier SKU and visual variant; creative footage does not establish physical stock, specifications, included accessories, safe operating instructions or fulfillment.
Review original audio by listening and verify reuse rights; metadata is not audio acceptance.

Heating temperature, power, battery, charging cable inclusion, timer and safety limits are not established.
Do not convert illustrative comfort reactions into guaranteed pain relief, clinical efficacy or safe all-day/under-clothing use.

videos.observed_description_draft: A pink portable blender bottle with a transparent cylindrical container, matching lid and base, wrist loop and front power control. A metal blade assembly is visible inside the base of the container.
claims_and_quality: Do not advertise it as a pulp-separating juicer: sampled visuals show a blender bottle.

The independently viewed 26-second product card visibly depicts four exposed blade arms, while an earlier subtitle claims 6 blades. Do not repeat the six-blade specification without exact SKU verification; this is a visible creative inconsistency.
Blade count, capacity, battery, motor power, materials, food-contact certification, liquid temperature limits and included cable are unverified.
Food preparation scenes are illustrative demonstrations, not verified blend-time or nutritional evidence.
No sampled detox, weight-loss or medical claims.

handoff: Root should reconcile exact SKU, embedded price, COD and website/CTA before deciding whether unchanged videos can be published. Factual captions do not neutralize claims already embedded in video. No store changes, external publication or acceptance performed by this lane.
